lines: [SYSTEM INFORMATION: Press H to toggle help.]
OH MY GOD, WE'RE UNDER ATTACK!
[SYSTEM ALERT: Automated Electronic Warfare offline. Manual Antenna & Radar arrays operational.]
Our auto jammers are fried! We have to manually match their signal frequencies to cancel them out!
[WARNING: Defensive systems compromised. Three impacts will destroy the station!]
We can take a couple of hits, but don't push your luck!
Use the PLUS sign to add a wave, hurry!
Match the height of both waves, using the amplitude knob!
That's three contacts neutralized! More recon drones are approaching!
Look closely at the waves. Their heights match, but something is still different.
One oscillates faster than the other. That's FREQUENCY!
Adjust the FREQUENCY knob until their peaks line up!
Excellent work, operator! We're almost through this!
These signals are trickier. Their height and frequency are identical, but they're shifted relative to each other.
Turn the PHASE knob until the waves line up perfectly!
[RADAR ALERT: No remaining hostile contacts detected.]
That's the last of them! Outstanding work, operator!
You've got the basics of signal matching down. But don't get comfortable... there's plenty more out there.
